name: @arp/probe
description: A Cloudflare Worker that asks every remote MCP endpoint in the catalogue whether it answers, and reads every package's registry record, on a five-minute cron. Keeps the history in D1. A dated fact measured by ARP, never written on chain, never a score (ADR 0093).

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply PROBES --local && wrangler dev --test-scheduled --port 8788
